newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Iran pulls OPEC output up in August - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Iran pulls OPEC output up in August - MEES.

text.p: OPEC oil production in August rose 100,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 25.69 million bpd, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) reported on Monday.
"The increase was attributable to a higher output from Iran, where crude production is estimated to have risen by 110,000 bpd to 3.75 million bpd," the Cyprus-based weekly reported.
Iran has an OPEC quota of 3.60 million bpd.
Iranian crude exports in August rose 114,000 bpd in August to 2.652 million bpd, MEES reported.
Maintenance work cut Nigerian crude production to 1.97 million bpd, its lowest monthly figure registered this year, and compares with its OPEC quota of 1.865 million bpd.
Venezuela remained the group's largest quota buster, pumping 3.07 million bpd in August, unchanged from July, but above its OPEC quota of 2.359 million bpd.
OPEC agreed a new ceiling of 25.033 million bpd at its last ministerial meeting in June.
